notes.title: Steam Chronicle #38: Content Complete!
notes.content:
[h3]Nextfest and Other Events![/h3][p]
Firstly, letting you all know that Shrine's Legacy will be part of the indie.io (our publisher) booth at [b]Gamescom[/b] in Germany on August 20th to 24th! We won't be personally present, but if you are there feel free to check out the booth and show your support. :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, we've had an amazing last month for events in general! We participated in the June [b]Steam Nextfest[/b], which was active until June 16th (big thanks to everyone who checked out the demo during that time!), and were also being shown by a friend at a convention in Canada called [b]Game Con Canada[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We most recently also participated in the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QAanpHTfrAw"]Indie Quest 2025 Showcase[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hyRhu8kWv2E"]The MIX Summer Showcase[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Check out our [b]updated trailer[/b] AND our [b]new trailer[/b] on YouTube:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updated Trailer:
[/b][/p][previewyoutube="BNY60dWDWkU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]New Trailer:[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DY-IaYs14Js;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We've had some great results from these events and our wishlists are currently looking pretty promising![/p][p][/p][h3]Content Complete[/h3][p][/p][p][b]The game is now tested and fully playable with the entire story now integrated front to back.[/b] But there are still some optional scenes, a handful of puzzles, and more detailed collisions missing or buggy for many rooms. There are also some sprites and sound effects that have been made already but that still need to be properly implemented into the correct parts of game. And other random things like steam achievements still must be done.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cutscene Progress[/h3][p][/p][p]All main story cutscenes are now complete! Some of them, especially in the late game, still need a healthy layer of polishing wax, however. I've been finding it hard to choose cutscenes to show that won't be spoilery, so please forgive me. Instead, [b]please check out the new trailers above and await the upcoming release date announcement trailer for more spicy stuff[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]Map Progress[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New maps were made![/b] Now all the maps are on a first draft at minimum, though many will be returned to for some final polish. 💪[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/80bf2b35af16920e11994094d50a7349559d00ff.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4a3e4b0850235f006620cedd13284a7059c603b7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/104547461b0f621d6de5c61bd930782038df6330.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Closing[/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading another Steam Chronicle![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #32: Boss AI Done + Feature Complete
notes.content:
Some big news this update: the Boss AI is completed! We are now also officially in the "Feature Complete" stage. There's still a ton of work to do on content, but it's still a huge milestone for us.

[h1]Boss AI Complete[/h1]

As mentioned above, the AI for all bosses is now complete! I wanted to show off at least one so here is one of the early game bosses after the end of the demo (note that some things like sound effects are still not implemented, and boss behavior is subject to change / polish):

[previewyoutube=L2T-D2d_GMI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Dungeon and Map Progress[/h1]

There's been some mapping progress on the Marsh dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/18401d5a3008ce28f203b1ecca62b662b58280ef.png[/img]

And additionally, many new rooms in the overworld are now mapped!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d270d3a7e90de2e68a10488fb83e60d7f200eeb7.png[/img]

[h1]Pixel Art Progress[/h1]

More pixel art has also been completed! Here is a small sample preview of the many new jewel, potion, and item icons that have been made:


[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

Alan is done going through the cutscenes and adding portrait expressions! Additionally, a good chunk of new in-game cutscenes have been scripted.

The next couple months will be mostly dedicated towards scripting cutscenes in-game. Expect a non-spoilery cutscene preview or 2 in the next couple updates! 🙂

[h1]Closing[/h1]

Completing the Boss AI is a big milestone for me personally. It's been really cool seeing them all come to life, and I can't wait to see people take them on once the game has been released! Thanks as always for reading, and...

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #31: Lotsa Random Stuff!
notes.content:
[h1]Updated GameMaker + Bugfixes[/h1]

I did something I've been putting off for a while and updated our game development IDE to the newest version. This brought some new bugs with it I needed to fix which took some time. But I also took it as an opportunity to fix a lot of long-time bugs I never got around to dealing with. There's still a handful I haven't had time to get to, but it will really help out later having a big chunk of them out of the way.

[h1]Cutscene Progress[/h1]

Alan is almost done going through the entire script of the game and adding character expressions to the portraits throughout! He's reached chapter 20 out of 21, so there's only 2 remaining now!

[h1]Dungeon and Map Progress[/h1]

Postcat Jeff minigame is now mostly functional! Some aspects are still incomplete but this video should give you a pretty good idea of how it will work. You control Jeff the Postcat as he moves on a grid like old-school maze type games. You try to avoid the obstacles and get to the end, maybe collecting some things along the way to open up the path!

[previewyoutube=Y6GqL1I1HgU;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also gotten started planning out the mapping for another dungeon, the Hendran Marsh! There's nothing new to show yet, but there most likely will be next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c6ee93bebf6fc699eca8ac990aa3bab966ec14d6.png[/img]

[h1]NPC Pixel Art Progress[/h1]

We're almost done with NPC's! We have one more batch in the making right now, and then there will only be a few misc NPC's and extra pieces of art for them needed.

Here's a small sample of the last batch of NPCs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d3126fe486effd3d2d386f21175ed5c018bdc816.gif[/img]

[h1]Closing[/h1]

That concludes yet another update! With some of this other work out of the way, next time around expect all the remaining boss AI to be completed. 💪

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #30: Boss AI Underway and Sounds finished!
notes.content:
[h1]Boss AI[/h1]

The in-game AI for approximately 10 new bosses has been implemented, and all the art for each boss has been imported and is ready to be used to make the remaining boss AIs.

As a celebration of this, take a look at one of the new bosses in action: the Sand Hydra! This boss was also made through collaboration with one of our producer tier backers. 🙂

[previewyoutube=1DDlKF6G99Y;full][/previewyoutube]

It's important to note that each of the 3 heads has its own statistical and elemental properties so you'll need to experiment if you want to discover the most effective way to defeat each one.

[h1]Sound Effects Completed[/h1]

All of the sound effects for the game have been completed. Some of the new sound effects were put to good use in the video above with the Sand Hydra!

[h1]Dungeon and Map Progress[/h1]

With spooky season coming, it only makes sense to show off some of the major updates to a spooky dungeon called Moglore Woods. Here's a shot of the woods in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/7f89a6a63aacc0df2ab80f7f077b9a242799758e.png[/img]

[h1]NPC Pixel Art Progress[/h1]

Another hefty chunk of new NPC's have been created! Here's a sampling of just a few of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/0255729d8fc9c45daa4005a993bc43f03ff5ffef.gif[/img]

[h1]Closing[/h1]

This has been a bit of an intense month for us working on Shrine's Legacy, trying to keep progress flowing at a steady rate! But it's been extremely exciting seeing the bosses and world come to life, and I get a little bit more antsy to finish things the further we get along.

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #27: Music, Sound, NPCs, and Dungeons
notes.content:
Happy July and I hope everyone had a good weekend!

First I wanted to share some exciting news. We had the opportunity to be briefly showcased on [b]IGN Live[/b], where we shared some footage of a [b]new gameplay trailer[/b]! If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, I definitely recommend checking it out, as it has some new footage that hasn't been seen before. I’m planning to add it to Steam here shortly as well!

[previewyoutube=zLZPkUI9zmk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Dungeon Progress[/h1]

[b]Mapping for the final dungeon is now complete! [/b]Part of me is sad we won't be showing it off, because in my opinion it's turned out really great. But I think it's going to be an awesome surprise for you when you play the finished game. 😉

There's also been a lot of progress in the maps for[b] Veyrlorn Palace[/b]. It is now complete minus a bit of fixes and polish, and a few story-oriented rooms we're saving for a bit later.

[previewyoutube=qgrmDB05b-Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to progress on previous dungeons, [b]mapping for 2 more dungeons has begun[/b]. One of them is a [b]secret optional dungeon[/b]. The other one is the [b]Crystal Cavern[/b], which was very briefly shown in our newest trailer recently. Here's a screenshot of how the aesthetic is coming along!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/d12cf190cb103fffe1c26ce239fe02f661c2ef3f.png[/img]
[h1]Music[/h1]

More music tracks have been written. You can hear one in the Veyrlorn Palace video above. 🙂

[h1]NPC Placeholders and Dialogue Implemented[/h1]

Previously we had most of the NPC dialogue written. [b]Now it is implemented in all the towns using placeholder NPCs![/b]

[h1]Boss Art[/h1]

The two bosses pixel arts that were in progress have been completed, and the [b]final remaining boss pixel arts are now in the process of being created[/b] (and pretty deep in the progress to getting finished)! 

After we finish the boss art, we'll be getting started on new [b]NPC art[/b].

[h1]Sound Effects[/h1]

Alan has been working on a lot of [b]new sound effects[/b] to add to the game! We haven’t got them implemented yet, but it’ll be exciting to hear all the new sounds in action when we do.

[h1]Closing[/h1]

Thanks for checking out another Steam Chronicle and I wish you all the best this July. If your climate is anything like ours, don't forget to spend time with your loved ones and enjoy the outside while the weather is still good!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #24: Dungeon Puzzles and Challenges Full Steam Ahead!
notes.content:
Happy April and welcome to Steam Chronicle #24! 🙂

Let's jump right into it.

[h1]Boss Art[/h1]

Art for 1 more boss is complete, and 2 more are very close to being complete!

[h1]Enemy / Battle Challenge and Puzzles for Dungeons[/h1]

Three more dungeons (one of them being final dungeon) have had their enemies, challenges, and puzzles placed. Many bugs were fixed with the more complex puzzle types. And in some cases, new ways of using elemental spells or new mechanics were added, such as minecarts in the Tunnel!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38833680/128e27e549d8d67784b7dadbdbf5113ebda897c8.gif[/img]

Pace should speed up from here since some of the more difficult mechanics and fixes were in the final dungeon, so it is very likely we'll have the remaining dungeons all prepped and ready for mapping for next month's update.

[h1]Parum Tunnel Mapping[/h1]

The mapping for Parum Tunnel is almost finished. Progress went slower than expected this month due to life factors and sickness on our mapper's end, but we're confident the pace will pick up soon.

That said, things are still coming along nicely!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38833680/ea7816b883371a1836825e53136a52b65b59f621.png[/img]

Closing

And with that, we put a close on Steam Chronicle #24. Thanks for reading as always!

Until next time,

Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #23: Enemies Completed and More
notes.content:
Hi! It's time for [b]Steam Chronicle #23![/b] Here’s some of our progress for this month:

[h2]Enemy AI[/h2]
[b]Enemy AI is now complete![/b] This also includes the recolors we plan on using and their AI.

For example, here's the AI for couple of late game recolors of early game enemies, as seen in our debug room (a place I've been spending a lot of time lately making these AI's):


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/5d97c93fef5d51c015ec13f4c1f19dc0a932982f.gif[/img]

[h2]Boss Art Progress[/h2]
We have art for [b]2 new bosses[/b] done and [b]3 more[/b] started. We also have the [b]concept art for all bosses except 1[/b] is now complete!

Additionally, and this one is important...[b] The art for the very final boss battle is completed![/b] Please forgive us for keeping most of these boss arts as a surprise for the time being. 😊

[h2]Tunnel & Mapping Progress[/h2]
The [b]Parum Tunnel[/b] dungeon now has all of its basic enemy placements, battle challenges, and puzzles roughly in place (subject to change as the mapping progresses). We've also added a new minecart and switch mechanic to keep this mini-dungeon interesting and fresh.

Additionally, our new mapper Deckiller has made his first bit of progress on the mapping for this dungeon. It's still WIP but take a look!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/b993f45744a3e4bcb05dc901767ef5971a334e71.png[/img]
[h2]Closing[/h2]
Thanks for reading Steam Chronicle #23 and hope you have a good March! Now if you'll excuse us for a bit, we're gonna go and play some of the newly released FF7 Rebirth! 😉

Until next time,
Joe

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #20: More Enemy Implementation
notes.content:
[h2]New Enemy Art[/h2]
Art progress has been going well for enemies. There are only a [b]few enemies[/b] left to get art for now, not including bosses! Many of which we haven't shown, so look forward to seeing them for the first time in the final game.

[h2]New Enemy AI[/h2]
[b]More enemy AI[/b] have been completed. Below you can see a couple of the new ones which [b]serve as obstacles[/b] rather than chasing down the player.

I'm personally a big fan of the [b]wall sliding enemy[/b], and a few among you might recognize its concept from a certain Super Nintendo Action RPG game. We haven't seen an enemy like that used in many (any?) other JRPG games so it seemed like a good homage to make! And the other enemy happens to be another homage, one that may be a little easier to guess! 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/8d5fd3d9e75d562ce0ac7d9582941ff25a8f0af6.gif[/img]
[i]The purple enemy gets faster every time you deal damage to it! It can become quite comical if you let it get too fast :)[/i]

[h2]A Look WAYY Back[/h2]
We shared this image as part of [b]#ThrowbackThursday[/b] on Twitter but I wanted to share it here too. It's a great example of how far we've come over the years through hard work, learning, taking feedback, and the help from our Kickstarter backers, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/59ac08188fc871d7526df1d596d8dccdcaae7864.png[/img]

The "OLD" image is [b]very old[/b], from back before the Kickstarter, and even further. It was before we really knew what we were doing with the project and how to make a game of this scale. The sprites were 4 times the size ([b]32x32[/b] tiles instead of [b]16x16[/b] tiles like we have now). This was very hard to work with and contributed to the lack of pixel art quality in the early build. I don't think I even have to mention just how much the character designs or UI has changed and improved. 😂 

[hr][/hr]
This was Steam Chronicle #20; thanks for reading as always! By the way, while I can't share a definitive release window for the game yet, we are getting closer and it's only a matter of time before we will be able to!

We'll keep doing our best, and we hope you do too! 🌟

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #18: Spells and Enemy Implementation
notes.content:
[h1][b]Elemental Magic Functionality[/b][/h1]

Elemental magic is nearing completion functionally. The core remaining issues with the wind spell's programming have been resolved and earth has been improved as well. 

Additionally, [b]every spell now has additional unique special effects[/b] when hitting enemies. For example, earth and wind spells now launch the enemy into the air, damaging them when they first hit, and when the enemy lands back on the ground.

[h1][b]New Art[/b][/h1]
We wanted to show off a brand new enemy sprite by an artist we just started working with named Johanna ( @JoVGHanna on Twitter)!

This fella is known tentatively as the Rolly Porci.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/1b05da6d2723d7cbd9e0176fafe2fa72241c0e5c.gif[/img]

Majestic, cute, and fierce all in one package.

[b][h1]Enemy Implementation[/h1][/b]
This past week we finally got to implementing some new enemies! The Newtiz is making good progress! 😀 🦎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/83bb03ac57b7672f4eaf19daf9d0e35fa33f309e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Closing[/b][/h1]
That's it for Steam Chronicle #18! Thanks as always, and…

Until next time, 😉

Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #17: Elemental Spell Updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Note about the Demo[/h2]
Please note that we will [b]take the demo down from Steam on September 15th[/b], so if you want to play it now is a good time. It is still available DRM-free through our mailing list at [url=http://shrineslegacy.com/]our Website[/url] though! The demo will return to Steam at a later time, probably during future events.

[h2]Wind Elemental Magic 💨[/h2]
We've just finished up the main functionality for the wind element for exploration! Instead of explaining what it does, it's best to see for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/21a212d95bb583bff8a7b3b609bfba5e019503c4.gif[/img]
[i]This spell will greatly expand your ability to explore around the world![/i]

As you can see, this will be a very great spell for getting around the world! We're really excited to see how people use it in the full game. With any luck, it won't totally break everything! 😆 But if it does, we'll aim for it to be in fun and cool ways. 😉

[h2]Earth Elemental Magic 🗻[/h2]
Next we're working on the abilities of the Earth spell, which can pull objects out from the ground, including treasures, platforms, and more. (Note: the bury graphic is a placeholder)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/48a50dc658063c8894fc88c44245345997261f37.gif[/img]

[h2]Closing[/h2]
Thanks for tuning in for Steam Chronicle #17!
Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #14: More Demo Updates + Clemmy Games Showcase
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to [b]Steam Chronicle #14![/b] It's Joe again this time. 😀

The demo is nearing its update time! Stay tuned to the [b]Clemmy Games YouTube channel on June 6th[/b], as they will be doing "[b]Best Indie Games Summer Showcase 2023[/b]" which we are part of! And...this is where we will be announcing the [b]exact day of the demo update![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/e09d44fbd89af39f42d1c4ffe5109603e5b5b0d7.jpg[/img]
[i]Be there or be Square![/i]
The big priority for the moment has still been working on the demo, but we do have some nice non-demo things to show off too! So then, onward to the updates since last month!

[h2]New Enemy[/h2]
This guy is still WIP but he'll be hopping around and shooting lasers at you in the future, so be prepared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/8022f93cb85db0081bc7ccd2012ddb7ea8e6beeb.gif[/img]
[i]And with a name like "Goreye" you can guess he's probably not very friendly.[/i]

[h2]Demo Update Progress[/h2]
We are finishing up the final graphical updates for the demo, along with a few more cool surprises! All the Groonis Island enemies are getting improvements, including the Groonis. But for now, here's the new and improved Sea Lurker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/fd5ff0db9dfa9846055ecd0d94381b689c7eb3b4.gif[/img]
[i]Yes, and he has an attack now! 🙂[/i]

Some of the art in Marize has also been improved, and you can see that the interiors have some new objects in them as well, such as a fireplace and oil lamp!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/e4df45bfd020ed16e80f7862e98a5b06192def64.gif[/img]
[i]The Hiroshi Bros are looking pretty spiffy too![/i]

[h2]Closing[/h2]
That about wraps it up for[b] Steam Chronicle #14![/b] Thanks for sticking around even while updates have been a bit slower! Looking forward to finishing up this demo update very soon and getting back to making more brand new content so we can get this game to ya'll! 💓
Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #13: Final Major Demo Update Incoming
notes.content:
Hello there, and welcome to [b]Steam Chronicle #13![/b] There’s a good amount to go over this time around, so let’s dive into it!

[h2]Final Demo Update and Progress[/h2]
Our goal is to prepare our final major demo update by [b]early June[/b], so that we can have it for the Steam Nextfest coming up. Aside from some new enemies and spell animations, the demo update has still largely been our focus this past month. We can't wait to share the final result of these updates and hopefully you will find them to be worth the wait. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c0bc354e17bbbe3a81e0fa9e8a670909624fe3e3.png[/img]

If you’d like to see more, we also just updated the Steam screenshots for the game! So be sure to check those out and drop a wishlist if you like what you see and haven’t done so yet. 🙂

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
Also, enemy sprite commissions are now fully underway! This is exciting because [b]we’ve focused on static level and overworld art for so long[/b] that it’s simply a breath of fresh air to design enemies. There is still the matter of programming their AI into the game, but this is still an exciting time for us. Here’s a sneak peek at a couple new/updated fiends below, this time made by DumpsterCat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4007e24e45ba8435ad6157f5abdbefdc95c4bb2d.gif[/img]
[i]The Metal Head has been reworked and animations completed![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/65702bc5dec8d66034e45f28f6feb538f50af48d.gif[/img]
[i]This ghosty may be cute but don't be fooled, he's a troublemaker![/i]

[h2]Mysterious Figure[/h2]
You may remember an unknown figure in a dark blue cloak at the start of the (soon to be outdated) demo. This character is even in the key art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/4b02827b3947387f83991b926cb3f3581520d807.png[/img]
[i]He thinks he's a sneaky fella out there on that cliff...[/i]

We’ve largely avoided talking about this [b]cloaked figure[/b]. I assure you that whoever this person is…they are important to the story in some way. [b]Is this person friend or foe?[/b] You’ll have to wait a while longer to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/c409e12d0f4ba3269cfe5e09256e0f0002b43684.gif[/img]
[i]Art update for this cloaked figure made by FinalBossBlues[/i]

Closing
Well, here we are at the close of Steam Chronicle #13. If you made it to the end, thank you. It sincerely means a lot that you took the time to read up on our current progress. Take care of yourselves and keep your mental health in check because it is very daunting when you’re stressed and overwhelmed. Always remember there are those who love and care about you. 💓


And please look forward to our (hopefully last) demo update next month! There will be some surprises in store for players…  😉


Be seeing you soon,


Alan

notes.title: Steam Chronicle #9: MAGFest, New Title Screen and Dungeon Art
notes.content:
[h3]New Title Screen[/h3]
The title screen sketch that we showed off last update is now finished and can be seen animating in game!
[previewyoutube=C0v-wRcD8IQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Art Updates[/h3]
Here is our first WIP mockup for Parum Tunnel, a mini-dungeon that takes place shortly after the end of the current demo on Steam! It'll get some tweaking (especially the floor and lights) before it's totally finalized but this should give you an idea of what to expect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/01f22370f13ddc7629d68494e3c7c63e98756e91.png[/img]
[i]Do you dig it?[/i]

Aaand, a small teaser for one of the dungeons that hasn't been shown yet! We'll keep this shot small to leave some mystery for this one. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833680/8d08db0674fc96e86b55807c0e72072c837fc47d.png[/img]
[i]What spooky things lay waiting in this forgotten place?[/i]

[h3]Closing[/h3]
That's it for Steam Chronicle #9! Don’t forget that we will be at MAGFest this weekend! So if you are going, be sure to give our booth a visit while you're there! I hope that 2023 treats you all well! This will be a tough but rewarding year for us, because we'll be doing our best to make this the year that Shrine's Legacy launches. Thank you for being here for us! 😊

Until next time,
Joseph

notes.title: Official Steam Demo release and Demo v1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 is now out[/h1]

In addition, you can now play the demo on Steam without joining the mailing list now! Just download the demo from the official Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/]Shrine's Legacy on Steam[/url]

[h2]Important Notes for those who have played the Mailing List Demo:[/h2]

Unfortunately, owning the mailing list demo may cause issues with downloading the new demo. Because of this, we will be disabling the Steam keys for the Mailing list version of the demo shortly, but the DRM-free version from our mailing list should continue to work if you wish to keep playing the older version in the future. Once we disable the Mailing List demo keys, you should no longer have any issues downloading the new version of the demo directly from Steam via the above link.

Additionally, if you played the demo via our mailing list before this, please note that the new version of the demo uses a new folder for storing config and save files, which means by default your save data and config settings will be gone when you start up the game again.

However, It is possible to copy the contents from the old folder to the new folder and they should work. Both folders should be in appdata for most windows machines. The old folder is called "Project_Shrine" and the new folder is called "Shrines_Legacy". 

If you copy the files over you should be able to continue where you left off. The new save files will not be backwards compatible though due to changes in how Game Maker handles save files in its newest version, so keep this in mind.

[h2]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.6 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Shrine's Legacy to the newest version of GameMaker Studio 2.
[*]It's now possible to switch characters and play co-op as soon as Reima joins the party.
[*]Uses a new folder to save and load config and save file data from.
[*]Somewhat major co-op changes, listed next.
[/list]
[h3]Co-op Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]When Player 2 triggers a cutscene by walking into a trigger, they will now be in control of that conversation (before, it was always P1).
[*]When the party changes, players will get to keep control of their respective characters they had BEFORE the party change.
[*]It's now possible for P2 to control P1 if there's currently no second character. You can switch between the two players at any time by pressing any major button or start button on the respective player's controller or keyboard.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Using a HP or MP increasing potion on a character that's not in the party no longer causes a potion to fly across space and time.
[*]Footstep sounds now properly play when important characters in scenes are running.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could potentially cause issues in a couple of different scenes in co-op mode when P1 was down at the end of a battle event.
[*]Fixed a mistake in the intro where the sprite of the character didn't quite match up when their eyes blink.
[*]Fixed a oversight where the game could think that a character is outside of a building when they are really inside the building.
[*]Fixed an exploit where Reima could get free EXP every time the player saves/loads at a specific moment in the game.
[*]Fixed a crash that could happen when loading the game with a specific jewel equipped to a specific character.
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed links to website and other places now that this is an official release of the demo. Also adjusted post-credits text a bit.
[*]Made an adjustment to a room in the first dungeon to make the way to progress easier to understand.
[*]Updated the art on the Postcat Office.
[/list]



Oh... also, we never actually posted patch notes for the v1.5 of the demo (and there were a lot!), so I'll include those here too:

[h2]Shrine's Legacy Demo v1.5 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Major Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]World Map added! You now get a map at the beginning of the game and can see the layout of the world of Ardemia!
[*]Many adjustments to combat and enemies to make both hitting and getting hit feel more impactful.
[*]We have a new Logo for the game now! It's implemented both on the Title Screen and in-game.
[*]A special surprise if you find and talk to the goats in the pen at the beginning.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slight rebalancing of most enemies and bosses.
[*]Knockback has been increased all around the board, both for players and enemies. Many enemies have had their hp has been slightly decreased to account for this.
[*]Enemies have slightly more damage on average.
[*]Dash attacks have slightly increased i-frames. You'll still take damage if dash attacking recklessly though.
[*]There is now hitstun when getting hit/ hitting enemies.
[*]When taking damage, you can't act instantly like before: there is now a short stun period where you can't do anything.
[*]Critical hits (i.e. exploiting weaknesses) now have new cool effects to show that you're dealing extra damage.
[*]You can now speak to npcs and examine objects from further away.
[*]Opening a treasure with a jewel in it now gives you a description of what that jewel does.
[*]Changed the wording and order of the options when speaking to Delane in Marize to make more sense and be clearer.
[*]The dummy juice is now slightly more effective. ;)
[*]If you are dashing but not holding the dash button, you'll now do a normal attack instead of a dash attack when attacking.
[*]Adjusted credits at end to be up-to-date.
[*]Lodestone jewel now pulls in pickups with less delay.
[*]Lots of small cutscene adjustments.
[/list]
[h3]Aesthetics:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Getting hit has much more effects now. Hitstun added, which makes it look more impactful when damage is dealt or taken. Players now flash red when hit as well.
[*]Adjusted the minions in the opening with the cloaked figure and added a new big minion.
[*]Player UI, boss health bars, enemy healthbars, revivebars and more have all been greatly improved visually.
[*]There are visual effects for stepping in certain terrain now, such as leaves in the grass, and footsteps in the sand on the beach.
[*]Wind-blown leaves now flow in the forest.
[*]Adjusted the shadow of the Froogah enemy and the hitbox of the friendly Froogah NPC.
[*]Adjusted Aklor's shadow positioning.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where your animation would reset every time you turned while dashing.
[*]Fixed an input bug where letting go of a button for exactly one frame, then repressing it would still count as you not pressing the button.
[*]If you are controlling Reima during the beginning of the mask fight, you will now automatically switch to Rio at the start of the fight.
[*]Fixed a small camera bug at the beginning of the final scene of the demo.
[*]The light orbs the mask boss could shoot had health and could be hit, but wouldn't be destroyed even at 0 hp. Now they are destroyed at 0 hp.
[*]You can no longer faintly see the cloud fog over the credits screen now.
[*]Fixed a bug where the light orbs surrounding the trap monsters could survive when finishing off the trap with an ice spell.
[*]Fixed a bug that would show text when rapidly exitting or entering Carolyn's basement via the door after speaking with the save point outside.
[*]Fixed a bug where Reima sometimes wouldn't move to the doorway properly for the scene when first entering Carolyn's house.
[*]Normally when attacking the slime boss, it will create it's next set of slimes quicker for each hit you land. This wasn't working for the second phase of the battle, but has now been fixed.
[*]Fixed three uncommon bugs related to 2 player mode and roofs appearing/disappearing at the wrong time in Marize.
[/list]

If you decide to play for the first time, hope you you enjoy the demo! And if you a returning player, we hope you enjoy the updates!

We also have a public Discord where we love to hear player feedback and ideas or even just chat! Check it out if you are interested: [url=https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD]https://www.discord.gg/KxnRukD[/url]

At any rate, that's all for now,

Until next time!
